data.conditions: 6 AM- Ladies and gentlemen, children of all ages, prepare for an alpine experience that's guaranteed to be totally outrageous. 7 more inches of wind-blown pow slathered the mountainside over the past 24 hours, with 3 of them buffing up the slopes after the lifts closed. Occasional breaks in the clouds will pop, shooting solar laser-beams between periods of continued snowfall. Strong winds swirling from the west will help clean the big-mountain canvas while sending you into an extended state of vapor-derived delirium. High temperatures will tickle the low 20s in the upper elevations while the Village hangs in the low 30s.
